exposure: first visit to KIMS Hospital (indicating lack of continuous antenatal care)
cohort: The study included patients with intrauterine foetal demise (IUFD) of at least 24 weeks gestational age and 500g birth weight from a tertiary care hospital over a 5-year period.
finding: The prevalence of IUFD was 17/1000 live births, with Hypertensive disorder of pregnancy (HDP) identified as the most common cause among those with a known cause.
